I now have a complete picture of the entire works page TypeScript and PHP stack. Here is the full audit.

---

## Works Page Architecture — Full Audit

### File Index

- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts` — Three.js canvas manager (scatter mode rendering, pointer events, camera motion)
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksPageRuntime.ts` — Page orchestrator (data loading, view mode switching, filter panel, drag hint UI, grid feed)
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/runtime/WorksIntroRuntime.ts` — Intro animation playback (`WorksIntroPlaybackRuntime`) and background canvas (`WorksBackgroundRuntime`)
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/scene/works.scene.ts` — All constants, configs, `WorksSceneDefinition` factory
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/theatre/WorksTheatreConfig.ts` — Theatre project/sheet/object IDs, intro config, `resolveWorksAuthorMode()`
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/theatre/WorksTheatreRuntime.ts` — Theatre singleton that scrubs keyframe state for playback
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/theatre/WorksTheatreBridge.ts` — Author/editor mode bridge with OrbitControls + Theatre Studio
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/types/work.types.ts` — All work-page types
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/api/getWork.ts` — API fetch functions
- `/c:/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/api/works.php` — PHP backend for works list/detail

---

### 1. WorksSceneManager — Full Structure

**Internal class breakdown (all private to the module):**

| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `WorksViewportRuntime` | Reads viewport size and DPR from `ResponsiveRuntime`; computes half-view bounds for an orthographic camera |
| `WorksHitRuntime` | Raycasting for hover and click — resolves the hovered mesh from a pointer position |
| `WorksCameraMotionRuntime` | All camera state: target XYZ, drag velocity, lerp-based frame update |
| `WorksMeshRuntime` | Creates card meshes from scatter positions; disposes geometry, material, texture |
| `WorksThumbnailRuntime` | Loads thumbnail images in batches of 4 via `FrameScheduler`, updates `CanvasTexture` |

**`WorksSceneManager` public API:**

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `init()` | Guard: skip if no projects; calls `start()` |
| `setViewMode(mode)` | Toggle between `"scatter"` and `"grid"`. Grid stops the RAF loop and clears pointer state; scatter calls `activateScatter()` and resumes the loop |
| `applyCategory(category)` | Filters visible meshes, reassigns target positions, re-centers camera, records blend start timestamp |
| `applyInitialScatterState()` | Applies the active category and resets camera Z to `baseCamZ` — called without intro |
| `showCanvas()` / `hideCanvas()` | CSS class + aria-hidden on the canvas element |
| `update(delta)` | Per-frame: advances camera lerp, position/opacity/scale lerp per mesh, filter blend easing |
| `dispose()` | Stops loop, removes all event listeners via cleanup array, disposes all meshes (geometry + material + texture), context loss |

**Camera initialization** (`start()` private method):

- Camera type: `THREE.OrthographicCamera`. Frustum computed from a perspective-style FOV formula: `halfHeight = tan(camFov/2 * π/180) * camZ`, `halfWidth = halfHeight * aspect`.
- Initial position taken from `introEntryState.camera.position` if provided; otherwise `(0, 0, camZ)`.
- `cameraMotionRuntime.primeFromCameraPosition(x, y, z)` seeds the lerp targets to match.
- On resize: frustum recalculated and `updateProjectionMatrix()` called. Renderer pixel ratio and size also updated.

**Camera reset:** there is no explicit public `reset()` method. The effective reset path is `applyInitialScatterState()` → `cameraMotionRuntime.setTargetZ(baseCamZ)` combined with `applyCategory()` calling `_centerCameraOnVisiblePositions()` → `setTargetPosition(cx, cy)`. The camera lerps back to that center over time via `updateFrame()`.

---

### 2. Scatter Mode Positioning

**Grid layout algorithm** (`buildScatterPositions`):

```
cols = ceil(sqrt(totalCards * (spreadX / spreadY)))
rows = ceil(totalCards / cols)
stepX = spreadX / cols
stepY = spreadY / rows
```

Every even row gets a `+stepX * 0.25` X-offset (brick stagger). Positions are centered around (0,0). Config values: `spreadX=188`, `spreadY=132`, `totalCards=128`.

The Y spread used for scatter positions is `spreadY * 0.88` (i.e., 116.16 units).

**Category filtering repositioning** (`applyCategory`):

- All meshes: keeps their full scatter position (pushed off-screen if out of category via opacity → 0).
- Visible meshes (matching category): reassigned from `categoryScatterPositions`, which is `scatterPositions` sorted nearest-to-center outward.
- `targetPositions[index]` holds the per-mesh target; `update()` lerps `mesh.position` toward it each frame.

**Filter blend animation** (in `update()`):

- `_filterBlendMs = 480ms` ease-out cubic.
- Exiting cards (wasIn && !nowIn): `targetY += (1 - filterEase) * 6.5` — slide down.
- Entering cards (!wasIn && nowIn): `targetY -= (1 - filterEase) * 7.5` (drop from above); opacity multiplied by `filterEase`.

**Opacity distance falloff:**

```
targetOpacity = max(0, min(0.92, 1 - (distance - 8) * 0.025))
```

Where `distance = dist2d(camera.x, camera.y, card.x, card.y)`. Out-of-category cards are forced to 0. Cards in a filtered category are floored at 0.3.

---

### 3. Drag / Pointer Event Handling

Handled entirely inside `bindEvents()` on the canvas element.

**Pointer events bound:**
- `pointermove` — hover resolution (when no active pointer) or drag update (when `activePointerId` matches)
- `pointerdown` — begins drag via `cameraMotionRuntime.beginDrag()`; captures pointer to canvas
- `pointerup` — if displacement < `_dragStartThresholdPx` (10px) and same mesh, fires `onSelect(detailPath)`
- `pointercancel` — resets pointer state
- `pointerleave` — clears hover when no active drag

**Drag velocity** (`WorksCameraMotionRuntime.updateDrag`):

Camera XY target is shifted by pointer delta converted to world units: `dx * (halfW * 2) / viewportWidth`. Velocity stored as `delta * 0.7` and decayed each frame by `velDecay^(delta*60)` (config value `0.92`). Camera XY clamped to `±(camPadX - halfW)` and `±(camPadY - halfH)`.

**No mouse wheel / scroll zoom on the scatter canvas.** There is no `wheel` listener on the canvas itself. The wheel listener in `WorksPageRuntime._handleWheel` only triggers `showDragHint()` when `deltaY >= 1` and view is scatter — it is purely a hint trigger, not a zoom or scroll control.

---

### 4. Drag Hint UI

**Configuration** (`WORK_HINT_CONFIG` in `works.scene.ts`):

```ts
enabled: false,       // CURRENTLY DISABLED
autoHideMs: 4200,
hideStartDelayMs: 160,
exitDurationMs: 320,
```

**The drag hint is disabled by default** (`enabled: false`). All `showDragHint()` calls are guarded by `if (!WORK_HINT_CONFIG.enabled) return`.

**DOM selector:** `[data-works-drag-hint]` → `WorksPageElements.dragHint`

**CSS classes:** `is-visible` (added on show), `is-hiding` (added on hide transition start). Both removed at rest.

**Lifecycle in `WorksPageUiRuntime`:**

- `showDragHint()` — unhides element, adds `is-visible`, removes `is-hiding`, sets an auto-hide timeout for `autoHideMs`
- `hideDragHint()` — clears show timer, after `hideStartDelayMs` removes `is-visible` and adds `is-hiding`, then after `exitDurationMs` sets `inert` + `aria-hidden`
- `showDragHintIfNeeded(state)` — called at scatter startup; guarded by `enabled` and `state.view === "scatter"`

**Trigger points in `WorksPageRuntime`:**

- `_handleWheel` — fires `showDragHint()` when a wheel event arrives in scatter mode and author canvas is not being dragged
- `onInteractionStart` callback passed to `WorksSceneManager` — fires `hideDragHint()` when a real drag of ≥10px is detected on the scatter canvas
- `_bindAuthorCanvasHint` — when in author/theatre mode, `pointerdown` on the canvas sets `_authorCanvasDragging = true` and calls `hideDragHint()`

---

### 5. Filtering Logic (full stack)

**PHP layer** (`api/works.php`, `worksData::selectRows`):

```sql
SELECT ...
FROM `nb_works`
WHERE `is_visible` = 1
  AND `deleted_at` IS NULL
  [AND JSON_CONTAINS(`category`, CAST(:category_json AS JSON))]
ORDER BY `sort_no` DESC, `id` DESC
LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
```

- `sort_no` — an integer column (separate from `id`) used for admin-controlled display ordering. Higher `sort_no` appears first. There is no `notice` field on `nb_works`; that field exists only on board tables.
- `category` DB column stores a JSON array of integer IDs (e.g. `[3, 7]`). Filtering uses `JSON_CONTAINS` with the resolved integer category ID.
- `is_visible = 1` guards all public queries; `deleted_at IS NULL` is the soft-delete guard.
- Pagination: `LIMIT n+1` technique — fetches one extra row to determine `hasMore` without a separate `COUNT(*)`.

**API layer** (`getWork.ts`):

`fetchWorksList(offset, limit, category, signal)` sends `GET /works/list?offset=N&limit=N[&category=slug]`. The category slug is passed as a string; the PHP layer resolves slug → integer ID via `categoryMap()` from global `$work_category_slugs`.

**Scatter canvas layer** (`WorksProjectsLoader` in `WorksPageRuntime`):

For scatter mode, a single upfront fetch loads up to `totalCards=128` items (batched at `WORKS_LIST_API_MAX_LIMIT=24` per request, iterated until `hasMore=false` or 128 reached). The category from the initial page state is passed to the API — so the PHP layer handles the scatter data filtering. On the canvas, `applyCategory()` does a client-side re-filter of the already-loaded meshes (all 128 share the same `activeCategory` — no re-fetch on filter change in scatter mode).

**Grid layer** (`WorksGridFeedRuntime`):

Grid view fetches fresh paginated data from the API per page/category state (including category in the query param). Infinite scroll is bound to `window scroll` with a `280px` bottom threshold.

---

### Rule Violation Audit

No violations found in the TypeScript layer:

- `dispose()` is implemented and covers geometry, material, texture, renderer, scene, and all event listeners via the `cleanup` array.
- No object creation inside the render loop — meshes are created once in `start()`, target positions updated as plain data, no `new THREE.*` calls in `update()` or `animate()`.
- All types are in `work.types.ts` — no inline type definitions in the render or runtime files.
- All shared utilities (`FrameScheduler`, `ResponsiveRuntime`, `Aria`, `disposeObject3D`) live outside the page folder.
- `addEventListener` / `removeEventListener` are symmetrical: the cleanup array in `bindEvents()` covers all six canvas listeners and the window resize listener.

One note: `WorksTheatreBridge` creates `OrbitControls` using `new OrbitControls(camera, domElement)` but its `dispose()` calls `this._controls.dispose()` — compliant. The three `removeEventListener` calls for `start`/`end`/`change` are also present.
